insights.osTooltipMacOs: Audience with a work environment typical of builders, founders and creative profiles.
insights.osTooltipWindows: Usually signals broad traffic, recruiters and users in a more corporate context.
insights.osTooltipIos: Polished mobile sessions; useful for checking that your profile looks good on iPhone.
insights.osTooltipAndroid: A good indicator of broad mobile reach beyond the more Apple-centric niche.
insights.osTooltipLinux: Very technical traffic; usually comes from devs, OSS and more infra-focused profiles.
insights.osTooltipDefault: Helps you understand which operating ecosystem your profile is being consumed in.
insights.browserTooltipChrome: Usually dominates general traffic; works as a baseline to compare the rest.
insights.browserTooltipSafari: Important for checking how your profile is perceived on Apple devices.
insights.browserTooltipFirefox: Common among technical audiences and users more careful about privacy.
insights.browserTooltipEdge: May signal traffic from companies, recruiters or corporate environments.
insights.browserTooltipSamsung: A clear sign of Android mobile consumption.
insights.browserTooltipInstagram: Sessions embedded from the app; it's worth prioritizing quick, visual CTAs.
insights.browserTooltipFacebook: Social traffic from the app's in-app browser.
insights.browserTooltipLinkedin: Usually correlates with networking or recruiting visits.
insights.browserTooltipDefault: Identifies where visual QA is worthwhile and which browsing context dominates.
insights.referrerTooltipX: Fast discovery traffic. If it grows, your posts or replies are driving visits.
insights.referrerTooltipGoogle: High intent: people are actively finding you through search.
insights.referrerTooltipLinkedin: A sign of professional networking and visits with a work context.
insights.referrerTooltipGithub: A good proxy for technical interest or traffic from projects and repos.
insights.referrerTooltipInstagram: More visual, mobile-first traffic; it matters that your profile loads clearly and fast.
insights.referrerTooltipYoutube: May come from demos, talks or evergreen content with a longer shelf life.
insights.referrerTooltipDirect: Includes direct traffic, copied links, DMs or sessions where no reliable referrer is available.

insights.deviceTooltipMobile: If it dominates, it's worth prioritizing a compact visual hierarchy and above-the-fold blocks.
insights.deviceTooltipDesktop: More room to explore; usually correlates with work or research visits.
insights.deviceTooltipTablet: Lower volume, but useful for spotting intermediate layouts that may break.
insights.deviceTooltipDefault: Helps you understand the physical context in which people are browsing your huevsite.

privacy.metaDescription: How we collect, use, and protect your data at huevsite.io.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: At huevsite.io we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it. If you have questions, write to us at <mail>hi@huevsite.studio</mail>.
privacy.section2Intro: We collect the following types of data:
privacy.section2Account1: Email and name (when you sign up or authenticate with GitHub)
privacy.section2Account2: Profile photo (optional, from GitHub or uploaded by you)
privacy.section2Usage1: Content blocks you create on your profile
privacy.section2Usage3: Activity on the platform (profile views, clicks)
privacy.section3Intro: We use your data exclusively to:
privacy.section3Item1: Provide and improve the huevsite.io service
privacy.section3Item2: Authenticate your account and keep your session active
privacy.section3Item3: Show you relevant notifications about your profile
privacy.section3Item4: Send you transactional emails (payment confirmations, account changes)
privacy.section3Item5: Analyze aggregate platform usage to improve the experience
privacy.section3Item6: Process your Pro subscription through LemonSqueezy
privacy.section3Outro: We do not sell, rent, or transfer your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.section4Body1: When you create an account on huevsite.io, we add your email to the personal newsletter written by Tomás (founder of huevsite.io). It's a low-frequency newsletter (typically 1-2 sends per month) focused on applied SEO and organic growth, with real experiments drawn from the products he's building in parallel — huevsite.io and <creatibro>creatibro</creatibro>.
privacy.section4Body2: You can unsubscribe at any time from:
privacy.section4Item1: The "unsubscribe" link at the bottom of any newsletter email
privacy.section4Item2: The "Newsletter" toggle in your dashboard settings
privacy.section4Body3: Users who registered before this clause took effect (May 2026) were not added automatically and can activate the subscription manually from the dashboard.
privacy.section5Intro: To operate huevsite.io we use the following external services, each with its own privacy policy:
privacy.section5SupabaseBody: Database and authentication. Your data is stored on secure Supabase servers.
privacy.section5LemonBody: Payment processing for the Pro plan. LemonSqueezy handles your payment information; we do not store card data.
privacy.section5GithubBody: OAuth authentication and public data from your GitHub profile (repositories, stars, followers) when you connect your account.
privacy.section5UmamiBody: Anonymous, cookie-free usage analytics. It does not collect personally identifiable information.
privacy.section5BeehiivBody: Platform for the founder newsletter. It stores your email and uses it exclusively to send you the newsletter you're subscribed to.
privacy.section6Body1: We use essential cookies to keep your session authenticated. For analytics we use Umami, which does not use cookies and processes data anonymously.
privacy.section6Body2: We do not use third-party tracking cookies or behavioral advertising.
privacy.section7Item1: Access: request a copy of the data we hold about you
privacy.section7Item3: Deletion: request that we delete your account and personal data
privacy.section7Item4: Portability: receive your data in a standard format
privacy.section7Item5: Objection: object to the processing of your data in certain cases
privacy.section7Outro: To exercise any of these rights, write to us at <mail>hi@huevsite.studio</mail>. We respond within a maximum of 30 days.
privacy.section8Body: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data: HTTPS connections, secure authentication, restricted database access, and periodic review of permissions. However, no system is 100% secure. If you find a vulnerability, report it to <mail>hi@huevsite.studio</mail>.
privacy.section9Body: We keep your data while your account is active. When you delete your account, we erase your personal data within 30 days, unless we are required to retain it for legal obligations.
privacy.section10Body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through a notice on the platform. The "last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when it was last revised.
privacy.section11Body: For any privacy inquiry or to exercise your rights, contact us at <mail>hi@huevsite.studio</mail>.

terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions of use for huevsite.io — the platform for builders.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Body: By accessing or using huevsite.io, you accept these Terms of Service in full. If you do not agree with any of these terms, do not use the platform. huevsite.io is operated by huevsite.studio, contactable at <mail>hi@huevsite.studio</mail>.
terms.section2Body1: huevsite.io is a social portfolio platform for builders and creators. It lets you create public profiles, showcase projects and skills, connect GitHub accounts, interact with other builders, and access premium tools via a Pro subscription.
terms.section2Body2: The free plan includes basic features. The Pro plan ($9 USD/month, processed through Lemon Squeezy) unlocks additional features such as more content blocks, custom domains, and advanced tools. We also offer the Founder plan ($79 USD, one-time payment) with lifetime access to Pro features. Prices may be updated; changes do not apply retroactively to active subscriptions.
terms.section3Intro: By using huevsite.io you agree to:
terms.section3Item1: Provide truthful information in your profile
terms.section3Item2: Not publish offensive, discriminatory, or illegal content, or content that infringes the rights of third parties
terms.section3Item3: Not use the platform for spam, phishing, or fraudulent activities
terms.section3Item4: Not attempt to access other users' systems or accounts without authorization
terms.section3Item5: Not use automated scripts to extract data in bulk
terms.section3Item6: Comply with the applicable laws in your jurisdiction
terms.section3Outro: We reserve the right to suspend or delete accounts that violate these conditions, without prior notice and at our sole discretion.
terms.section4Body1: The content you publish on your profile (text, images, projects) remains yours. By publishing it on huevsite.io, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to display and distribute it within the platform for the purpose of providing the service.
terms.section4Body2: We do not sell or transfer your content to third parties. You can delete your content and your account at any time from your profile settings.
terms.section5Body1: The Pro plan is billed monthly. Payments are processed by LemonSqueezy, an external payment provider. You can cancel your subscription at any time; Pro access remains until the end of the billed period.
terms.section5Body2: We do not offer refunds unless required by applicable law. Prices may change with 30 days' notice to active subscribers.
terms.section6Body: You can delete your account at any time by sending an email to <mail>hi@huevsite.studio</mail>. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, engage in fraudulent activities, or pose a risk to the platform or its users.
terms.section7Body1: huevsite.io is provided "as is". We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, absence of errors, or that the service will meet all of your specific requirements.
terms.section7Body2: In no event will we be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the use of or inability to use the platform. Our maximum liability is limited to the amount paid for the service in the last 3 months.
terms.section8Body: We may update these terms from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by email or a notice on the platform. Continued use of the service after the notification implies acceptance of the new terms.
terms.section9Body: For any inquiry about these terms, write to us at <mail>hi@huevsite.studio</mail>.

referrals.metaDescription: Invite builders to huevsite.io. When 3 referrals activate PRO, you unlock 3 months of huevsite PRO free.
referrals.heroSubtitle: The huevsite.io referral program rewards you for bringing in people who really add to the community. If 3 of your referrals activate PRO, you get 3 months of PRO free.
referrals.step1Desc: From your dashboard you get a unique link to share on WhatsApp, X, Discord, or wherever your community hangs out.
referrals.step2Desc: Your referrals join huevsite through that link and create their profile with your code automatically attached.
referrals.step3Desc: Once you hit 3 PRO referrals, your reward kicks in: 3 months of huevsite PRO free.
referrals.communicateTitleLine2: It's about bringing in builders who fit.
referrals.communicateBody1: This program works best when you share your huevsite with people who are already building things, launching side projects, or looking for a better way to show themselves online.
referrals.communicateBody2: Send them your link with context: why you use huevsite, what it solved for you, and what they can publish there. That kind of invite converts way better than a plain “join us.”
referrals.channelsBody: WhatsApp, founder groups, Discord communities, X, product Slacks, and DMs to people who are already building.
referrals.afterBody: You can track progress from your panel without chasing anyone down manually. The counter lives inside the dashboard.
referrals.faq1Q: What counts as a valid referral?
referrals.faq1A: A builder who arrives via your link, creates their profile, and then activates PRO. The progress shows up in your dashboard.
referrals.faq2Q: Where do I find my link?
referrals.faq2A: In your dashboard, inside the Referral Program module. That's also where you see how many PRO referrals you've racked up.
referrals.faq3A: Yes. Once you hit the goal, the benefit gets activated automatically on the platform.
referrals.finalCtaTitle: If you already use huevsite, you already have something to share.
referrals.finalCtaBody: Head to your dashboard, copy your referral link, and start bringing in people worth having around.

linktree.importHintPrefix: You can also paste the full URL:
linktree.socialProof: Hundreds of builders have already migrated from Linktree
linktree.urlError: Enter your Linktree URL or your username.
linktree.compareBeforeCaption: Loose links. No context. No community.
linktree.benefit1Desc: Paste your Linktree URL and we bring in your bio, avatar, and all your links automatically. No copying them one by one.
linktree.benefit2Desc: Projects, GitHub, tech stack, metrics. Not just loose buttons — a profile that says who you really are.
linktree.benefit3Desc: Public score, launch feed, real visibility. You join a network that values what you do, not just what you have.
linktree.step1Desc: Any Linktree or Bio.site link. We process it in seconds.
linktree.step2Desc: Bio, avatar, and links already on your profile. You start with a solid base, not from scratch.
linktree.step3Desc: Fine-tune what you want, and in 3 minutes your URL is ready to share.
linktree.faq1Q: Do I have to redo everything from scratch?
linktree.faq1A: Not at all. We import what you already have on Linktree and you start from there. It's a base, not a blank canvas.
linktree.faq2A: No. Your Linktree still exists. You can keep both until you're convinced to stick with just huevsite.
linktree.faq3A: Yes. Free to start with up to 5 blocks. Move up to PRO when you need more space or your own domain.
linktree.faq4Q: How is it different from a list of links?
linktree.faq4A: A lot. A huevsite profile has projects, GitHub stats, stack, metrics, and a score in the community. It's a portfolio, not a hub.
linktree.ctaSubtitle: Free to start. No credit card. Ready in 3 minutes.
